PCA basis from an aggregated covariance matrix

Source: R/pool.R
pool_covariance.Rd

Computes the eigenvectors of the average record covariance matrix. This is the basis obtained by a federated PCA that shares p x p covariance matrices instead of p x q bases.

Usage

pool_covariance(
  X_list,
  q = 10L,
  weights = NULL,
  center = TRUE,
  return_cov = FALSE
)

Arguments

X_list

A list of beat matrices.

q

Number of components.

weights

Optional record weights.

center

Center each record before computing its covariance.

return_cov

Return the assembled covariance matrix as well.

Value

A bp_basis object; with return_cov = TRUE a list with the basis T and the covariance S.
